author: yooitstim
body:
Hello,

 About 1 year ago i was banned from avicus for Aimbot, I admit i was hacking then,   but i had a lot of time to think about my mistake, and i would do anything to get one more chance. Please, this was my favorite server until i got banned.

 Sincerely,
Timothy Schwartz (BrickbusterPvP)

replies.body:
Greetings, BrickbusterPvP.

Seeing as you've waited a long time and I presume you've learned your lesson, I'll be appealing your ban.

That being said, welcome back to Avicus. Please make sure to abide by the rules this time, and have fun.

Sincerely,
